title: How to create Jira Epics and Stories in Velox

steps.narration: Velox turns a signed-off BRD into Jira Epics and Stories. This walkthrough goes from the requirements document to created stories which you can check in Jira.

beats.caption: From BRD to Jira Epics and Stories

steps.narration: First select your Project Workspace in the top right, then open the Confluence tab from the left rail.
Search by name to find the BRD or any relevant document you want to break down.

beats.caption: Browse the BRDs in your space

steps.narration: Select it, and the document opens on the right so you can go through the document.
Click Generate Jira Items button, and Velox reads the document and starts generating the Jira tickets.

beats.caption: Generation takes few minutes depending on the selected document

steps.narration: Generated Epics can be expanded to read its Stories, each carrying acceptance criteria and the requirement it came from.

beats.caption: Epics and Stories that trace to requirements

steps.narration: Tick only the Stories you want, nothing reaches Jira unless you select it.

beats.caption: Select the Stories that you want to create
by clicking the checkbox adjacent to that Story

steps.narration: Choose the board the selected Stories should land on in the linked Jira Space.

beats.caption: Pick a board from the linked Jira Space

steps.narration: Velox creates Stories in Jira, and takes you to the Jira tab to check what is created.

beats.caption: Push the selected Stories in Jira

steps.narration: It is synced with Atlassian's Jira, no data is stale for your consumption

beats.caption: Velox is synced with Atlassian's Jira

steps.narration: Open it in Jira to edit the ticket details and maintain your backlog.

beats.caption: Edit and refine your tickets in Jira

steps.narration: With the backlog created, you can take sprint planning forward in Jira.

variants.note: Baseline. Tutorials carry no hook or cta.
